preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the graph is between 2 and 3000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and the maximum possible number of edges, which is (n * (n - 1)) / 2.
Each node number and the starting node number is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The weight of each edge is between 0 and 10^5, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The function must return an integer representing the total weight of the minimum spanning tree (MST) of the graph.
